Animal.description: Emulate wild beasts, gaining lethal natural unarmed attacks.

features.name: Animal Instinct
features.tldr: Gain special unarmed combat attack choices (ape, bear, bull, frog, etc.) with unique traits.

Dragon.description: Channel draconic wrath, elemental resistance, and dragon breath.

features.name: Dragon Instinct
features.tldr: Gain dragon tail or jaw attacks, elemental damage bonuses, and a draconic breath weapon.

Fury.description: Pure unadulterated emotional rage without specific thematic restrictions.

features.name: Fury Instinct
features.tldr: Gain extra barbarian feat selections and absolute freedom of emotional expression.

Giant.description: Channel titan blood to wield massively oversized weapons with devastating reach.

features.name: Giant Instinct
features.tldr: Wield weapons one size larger than you with extra damage output and reach advantages.

Spirit.description: Channel ancestral or wandering spirits to strike ethereal foes.

features.name: Spirit Instinct
features.tldr: Deal spirit damage and protect yourself against spiritual and mental interferences.

Superstition.description: Fueled by deep distrust and hatred of magic and spellcasters.

features.name: Superstition Instinct
features.tldr: Gain massive saving throw bonuses against spells and magical effects while raging.
